srs_domain.description: Domain used for SRS rewriting (e.g., the domain of your mail server). Must be a valid, verified domain.

srs_secret.description: Secret key for signing/verifying SRS addresses. Must be ≥16 chars, randomly generated, and kept secret.

srs_forward_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to rewritten outgoing addresses. Standard is 'SRS0='.

srs_reverse_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to rewritten incoming addresses (for bounce handling). Usually same as forward prefix.

listen_port.description: TCP port on which postsrsd listens for Postfix lookup queries. Must be accessible to Postfix.

listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the postsrsd socket to. Use '127.0.0.1' for local Postfix; '0.0.0.0' only if remote.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed. Increase only for very high-throughput mail systems.

exclude_domains.description: List of domains to skip SRS rewriting for (e.g., internal domains with their own SRS).

debug.description: Enable verbose logging (true) or quiet operation (false). Enable only for troubleshooting.

chroot_dir.description: Chroot directory for security hardening. Leave empty for default (no chroot).
